skill.summary: Provides CI/CD pipeline configuration using GitHub Actions for Golang projects. Covers testing, linting, SAST, security scanning, code coverage, Dependabot,...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Added AI-powered code review integration instructions, including support for Claude Code and Copilot.
- New workflow file for Claude-based PR code review automation.
- Updated documentation to include guidance on AI review tools under a new "AI Review" stage in the Quick Reference.
- Improved clarity around using the latest stable major version for GitHub Actions.
- Minor documentation refinements across pipeline security, release, and dependency update sections.
